report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση πραγµατοποιήθηκε µε ακολουθίες T1 και PD µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ - Αναγνωρίζεται σηµαντική ποσότητα υγρού εντός της άρθρωσης, µε συνοδό εικόνα υµενίτιδας. - Από τον έλεγχο του πρόσθιου διαµερίσµατος παρατηρούνται χόνδρινες βλάβες της επιγονατίδας, χωρίς διάβρωση του υποκείµενου οστού (ICRS 3). Παθολογικού σήµατος ελέγχεται το υποεπιγονατιδικό λιπώδες σώµα του Hoffa, ενώ στην ίδια ανατοµική περιοχή αναγνωρίζονται 4 οζόµορφοι σχηµατισµοί ο µεγαλύτερος διαµέτρου 1.8εκ, οι οποίοι φέρουν φλοιό και οστικό µυελό  - Ο έλεγχος του έσω διαµερίσµατος ανέδειξε χόνδρινες βλάβες του µηριαίου κονδύλυ (ως ICRS 3 εστιακά). Σηµειώνονται υπαρθρικές κύστεις στο οπίσθιο τµήµα αµφοτέρων των µηριαίων κονδύλων µε συνοδό οίδηµα του περιβάλλοντος οστικού µυελού. Ακόµη σηµειώνονται επιχείλια οστεόφυτα εκατέρωθεν των µηριαίων κονδύλων καθώς και στον µεσοκοδύλιο βόθρο που δεν προκαλούν, ωστόσο, σηµαντική στένωσή του. Φυσιολογικοί ελέγχονται οι χιαστοί σύνδεσµοι. Εικόνα εκφύλισης, χωρίς ρήξη, παρατηρείται στο οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω µηνίσκου. - ∆εν σηµειώθηκαν παθολογικά ευρήµατα κατά τον έλεγχο του οπίσθιου διαµερίσµατος. ΣΥΜΠΕΡΑΣΜΑ - Εικόνα αρχόµενης οστεοαρθρίτιδας β/θώς σε φλεγµονώδη αρθρίτιδα. - Οζόµορφοι σχηµατισµοί στο σώµα του Hoffa που πιθανότατα αφορούν σε β/θή συνοβιακή οστεοχονδρωµάτωση.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 6 mm mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior -posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Medial kollateral ligamande periligamentöz ödem izlenmektedir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem düzeyinde kemik yapı köşelerinde osteofitik sivrileşme izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelmeler izlenmektedir. Ayrıca yer yer hafif destrüksiyon da izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı. Tibiofemoral eklem posteriorunda posterior çapraz bağ posterior komşuluğunda 3x2.5 cm boyutunda multiseptalı ganglion kisti izlendi. Gastrocnemius medial krus proksimali insersio düzeyinde tendonda tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Suprapatellar bursada hafif sıvı artışı izlendi. SONUÇ  : Gonartroz.Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati.Lateral meniküste grade II meniskopati.Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Tibiofemoral eklem düzeyinde periartiküler ganglion kisti. Gastrocnemius medial krus tendinozisi.Suprapatellar hafif bursit.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Rotura compleja, degenerativa del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial, sin desplazamiento de
segmentos con leve extrusión meniscal.
Rotura del cuerno anterior, cuerpo, cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz meniscal posterior del menisco lateral
con mínima extrusión de predominio marginal.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial lateral con
cambios óseos secundarios. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga
del cóndilo femoral medial.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de distribución difusa de la tróclea femoral.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios la faceta lateral y vértice de la rótula.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.
Trofismo muscular conservado.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con leve extrusión meniscal.
Rotura marginal del menisco lateral con parcial compromiso de la raíz meniscal posterior y leve extrusión.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 del compartimento femorotibial lateral. Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3
de la región central del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía superficial con lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la tróclea
femoral.
Condropatía rotuliana con lesiones grado 4.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa

Tiefergreifende Chondropathie femoropatellar insbesondere der Trochlea zentral sowie der medialen Facette. Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fabella. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Kollateralbänder intakt. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Überwiegend horizontrale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskushinterhorns, bis in die Pars intermedia reichend. Geringe Signalalteration des Außenmeniskus ohne eindeutige Rissbildung. Ruptur der Semitensinosussehne mit angrenzendem Hämatom welches sich entlang dem Semimenbranosus und Semitendinosus bis auf Höhe des medialen femurcondylus erstreckt (7/18, 4/32). Geringer Gelenkerguss. Bakerzyste. Plica mediopatellaris ([NAME] A). Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

Technique: MRI of the knee. MCL normal. ACL normal. Medial meniscus tear. Degenerative changes of lateral meniscus.  Chondromalacia of all three compartments. Degenerative changes grade 2. Fluid collections adjacent to the baker's cyst suggestive of rupture.  Conclusion: Medial meniscus tear. Suspected rupture of baker's cyst.

Moderate suprapatellar joint effusion, communicating with a large non ruptured Baker's cyst measuring just under 7 cm in maximal dimension, there are no intra-articular bodies.  
There is an extensive degenerative tear throughout the body and part of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with consequent medial extrusion at the level of the body. A small superiorly displaced fragment is appreciated posteriorly, at the junction of the corresponding posterior horn and root. 
 There is adjacent distal insertional semimembranosus tendinopathy.  
Intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, distal iliotibial band and the extensor tendons. No fracture or marrow infiltration.  Diffuse grade 3 articular cartilage thinning noted throughout the central third of the medial femoral condyle, but with no associated insufficiency type bony injury.  
Generally well-maintained remaining tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces.  Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

The study reveals normal knee joint alignment.   No fracture or bone contusion is seen.  
      Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen.  
    The MCL is intact.    Medial meniscus is not torn.  
    The FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.       
      Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
     Normal course with preserved signal of the ACL is noted.  The PCL is intact.  
     Minimal PF joint effusion is seen. 
      Mild hyperintense lateral PF cartilage with focal full thickness cartilaginous defect, about 2mm.,  
 at mild laeral patellar facet with small subhcondral bone cysts observed. .  
     The quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.     PF chondrosis with small chondral defect, grade 4 chondropathy, at mild lateral patellar facet. 
     No definite ligamentous tear.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There is focal osteochondral fracture at the anteromedial tibial plateau (about 1*1.2 cm).  
 The lateral compartment, there is suspected small radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Focal osteochondral fracture at the anteromedial tibial plateau (about 1*1.2 cm) 
  Suspected small radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

MRI  KNEE  -  LEFT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the left knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Two-week history of lateral knee pain in Marathon runner. X-ray negative. Please rule out lateral tibial plateau stress reaction.

COMPARISON:  None.

FINDINGS:

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. No retinacular disruption. No trochlear dysplasia. The tibial tuberosity to trochlear groove distance is 13 mm, within normal limits. The patellofemoral cartilage is intact.

The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament are intact.

The medial and lateral menisci are intact. Mild chondrosis of the lateral tibiofemoral cartilage. The medial tibiofemoral cartilage is maintained.

The medial collateral ligament is intact. The fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band are intact. There is mild soft tissue edema deep to the distal fibers of the iliotibial band.

No abnormal bone marrow edema. No acute fracture. No Baker's cyst. Trace joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION:

1. No evidence of fracture.
2. Soft tissue edema deep to the distal fibers of the iliotibial band, which may correlate with clinical features of iliotibial band syndrome. The iliotibial band itself is intact.
3. Mild chondrosis of the lateral tibiofemoral cartilage.
